name: Auto CI/CD GitLab - Multi Project & Branch

parameters.functionCode:
function javaMicroTemplate() {
  return `stages:
  - validate
  - build
  - test
  - coverage
  - sonar
  - package
  - docker
  - deploy
  - merge

variables:
  MAVEN_OPTS: "-Dmaven.repo.local=$CI_PROJECT_DIR/.m2/repository -Xmx2048m"
  SONAR_TOKEN: $SONAR_TOKEN
  SONAR_HOST_URL: $SONAR_HOST_URL
  DOCKER_DRIVER: overlay2
  DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR: "/certs"
  SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE: "test"

cache:
  key: ${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG}
  paths:
    - .m2/repository/
    - target/

validate:
  stage: validate
  image: maven:3.9-jdk-17-alpine
  script:
    - mvn validate

build:
  stage: build
  image: maven:3.9-jdk-17-alpine
  script:
    - mvn clean compile -DskipTests

test:
  stage: test
  image: maven:3.9-jdk-17-alpine
  script:
    - mvn test jacoco:report
  coverage: '/TOTAL.*?([0-9]{1,3})%/'

coverage:
  stage: coverage
  image: alpine
  script:
    - echo "Coverage generada con JaCoCo"

sonar:
  stage: sonar
  image: maven:3.9-jdk-17-alpine
  script:
    - mvn sonar:sonar -Dsonar.projectKey=$CI_PROJECT_NAME -Dsonar.host.url=$SONAR_HOST_URL -Dsonar.login=$SONAR_TOKEN
  rules:
    - if: $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_ID
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "develop"

package:
  stage: package
  image: maven:3.9-jdk-17-alpine
  script:
    - mvn package -DskipTests -Pprod
  artifacts:
    paths:
      - target/*.jar

docker_build:
  stage: docker
  image: docker:25-git
  services:
    - docker:25-dind
  before_script:
    - docker login -u $CI_REGISTRY_USER -p $CI_REGISTRY_PASSWORD $CI_REGISTRY
  script:
    - |
      APP_VERSION=${CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA}
      if [ "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" = "main" ]; then
        APP_VERSION="latest"
      fi
      docker build --platform linux/amd64 \
        -t $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$APP_VERSION \
        -t $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA \
        -f Dockerfile .
      docker push $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$APP_VERSION
      docker push $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA

deploy_k8s:
  stage: deploy
  image: bitnami/kubectl:1.29
  script:
    - |
      TAG=$CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA
      ENV="staging"
      KUBECONFIG_PATH="$KUBE_STAGING_CONFIG"
      if [ "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" = "main" ]; then
        TAG="latest"
        ENV="production"
        KUBECONFIG_PATH="$KUBE_PROD_CONFIG"
      fi
      echo "$KUBECONFIG_PATH" | base64 -d > kubeconfig
      export KUBECONFIG=kubeconfig
      kubectl set image deployment/$CI_PROJECT_NAME $CI_PROJECT_NAME=$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$TAG -n $ENV --record

merge_to_develop:
  stage: merge
  image: alpine
  before_script:
    - apk add --no-cache curl jq
  script:
    - |
      if [ "$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE" != "merge_request_event" ]; then
        echo "Not MR pipeline"
        exit 0
      fi
      MR_STATUS=$(curl --silent --header "PRIVATE-TOKEN: $GITLAB_AUTO_MERGE_TOKEN" "$CI_API_V4_URL/projects/$CI_PROJECT_ID/merge_requests/$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_ID")
      if echo "$MR_STATUS" | jq -e '.state == "opened" and .approvals_left == 0' > /dev/null; then
        curl --request POST --header "PRIVATE-TOKEN: $GITLAB_AUTO_MERGE_TOKEN" --form "merge_when_pipeline_succeeds=true" "$CI_API_V4_URL/projects/$CI_PROJECT_ID/merge_requests/$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_ID/merge"
      fi
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"
  allow_failure: true
`;
}

function simpleTemplate(type) {
  if (type === 'react' || type === 'angular') {
    return `stages:
  - install
  - build
  - test
  - merge

install:
  stage: install
  image: node:20
  script:
    - npm ci

build:
  stage: build
  image: node:20
  script:
    - npm run build

test:
  stage: test
  image: node:20
  script:
    - npm test

merge_to_develop:
  stage: merge
  image: alpine
  script:
    - |
      if [ "$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE" != "merge_request_event" ]; then
        exit 0
      fi
      curl --request POST --header "PRIVATE-TOKEN: $GITLAB_AUTO_MERGE_TOKEN" --form "merge_when_pipeline_succeeds=true" "$CI_API_V4_URL/projects/$CI_PROJECT_ID/merge_requests/$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_ID/merge"
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"
  allow_failure: true
`;
  }

  if (type === 'java') {
    return `stages:
  - build
  - test
  - merge

build:
  stage: build
  image: maven:3.9-jdk-17
  script:
    - mvn clean compile -DskipTests

test:
  stage: test
  image: maven:3.9-jdk-17
  script:
    - mvn test

merge_to_develop:
  stage: merge
  image: alpine
  script:
    - |
      if [ "$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE" != "merge_request_event" ]; then
        exit 0
      fi
      curl --request POST --header "PRIVATE-TOKEN: $GITLAB_AUTO_MERGE_TOKEN" --form "merge_when_pipeline_succeeds=true" "$CI_API_V4_URL/projects/$CI_PROJECT_ID/merge_requests/$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_ID/merge"
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"
  allow_failure: true
`;
  }

  if (type === 'docker') {
    return `stages:
  - build
  - test
  - merge

build:
  stage: build
  image: docker:25-git
  services:
    - docker:25-dind
  script:
    - docker build -t $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA .
    - docker push $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA

test:
  stage: test
  image: docker:25-git
  services:
    - docker:25-dind
  script:
    - docker run --rm $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA echo "Tests placeholder"

merge_to_develop:
  stage: merge
  image: alpine
  script:
    - |
      if [ "$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE" != "merge_request_event" ]; then
        exit 0
      fi
      curl --request POST --header "PRIVATE-TOKEN: $GITLAB_AUTO_MERGE_TOKEN" --form "merge_when_pipeline_succeeds=true" "$CI_API_V4_URL/projects/$CI_PROJECT_ID/merge_requests/$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_ID/merge"
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"
  allow_failure: true
`;
  }

  return `stages:
  - test

test:
  stage: test
  image: alpine
  script:
    - echo "Generic project - please customize CI"
`;
}

const { project_type, branch, project_id } = items[0].json;

let template;
if (project_type === 'java-microservice') {
  template = javaMicroTemplate();
} else {
  template = simpleTemplate(project_type);
}

return [{
  json: {
    project_id,
    branch,
    project_type,
    ci_yaml: template
  }
}];
